summary: The filing is a Form 6-K furnished by Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) reporting results of its annual general meeting (AGM) held on June 30, 2026. The AGM adopted financial statements, carried forward earnings without dividends, granted discharge to directors/CEO, re-elected six board members and auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers AB, and authorized share capital increases and share buybacks. No special situation—such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign—is present. The filing simply discloses routine corporate governance approvals and is classified as not a special situation.
